title: Proof-carrying projection protocol
rules: Every terminal claim carries a checkpoint trace.
Every required role must occur on the trace.
Required roles must occur in protocol order.
UNKNOWN propagates to terminal UNKNOWN unless a FAIL is present.
An empirical-authority claim is rejected unless all required checks pass.
threat_model: human fills a missing bridge with a plausible inference
LLM invents an intermediate causal edge
a state measurement is silently promoted to reachability
invariant: No endpoint claim may acquire more authority than its proof-carrying checkpoint trace.
boundary: The protocol validates trace completeness and fail-closed semantics, not the scientific truth of the records themselves.
